install_source.sglang: editable, --no-deps, from upstream/sglang @ ced0ef7d1bbbe703607b302ec86bb20a5c06bc8f (SGLang PR #42106 head, branch add_yue2)

deliberately_not_installed.flashinfer_python[cu13]==0.7.0.post1: CUDA-only wheel flavor; no ROCm build for this version. YuE2 fast paths that use it run behind env-gated fallbacks (Phase 3 adds/validates those fallbacks).
deliberately_not_installed.sglang-kernel==0.4.9 (metadata) / sgl-ke: CUDA kernel package; no ROCm wheel. Fallback paths required (Phase 3). Note version drift between PR prose (0.4.7) and pyproject at head (0.4.9).
deliberately_not_installed.aiter: AMD Instinct CDNA (gfx94x/gfx95x) kernel library; no gfx1151 build exists (verified: absent from repo.amd.com multi-arch index; PyPI 'aiter' is an unrelated 2019 package). Module-level `if _is_hip:` imports of aiter break import on gfx1151; patched with import guards (patches/0001-0003).
deliberately_not_installed.sgl-deep-ep, sgl-deep-gemm: DeepEP/DeepGEMM CUDA kernels (multi-GPU EP path); single-GPU mission does not need them.
deliberately_not_installed.tokenspeed_mla, torch_memory_saver, torc: MLA-speed kernel (CUDA), CUDA memory saver, and codec package with CUDA-flavored wheels; not required by the YuE2 path.

conflicts_with_upstream_metadata.torch: sglang pins torch==2.14.1 (CUDA); we run torch==2.12.0+rocm7.14.1 per mission rule 7 (never replace ROCm torch with CUDA torch). torchaudio==2.11.0 matches upstream's pin exactly; torchvision unpinned upstream (we use 0.27.0+rocm).
conflicts_with_upstream_metadata.diffusers: sglang diffusion extra pins 0.37.0; auto-resolver installed 0.41.0 (imported only for multimodal_gen vision utils; no version-sensitive usage on the YuE2 path; recorded, not silent).

build_notes.rust_extensions: sglang build requires cargo for Rust extensions; installed with SGLANG_BUILD_RUST_EXTS=none (documented in logs/phase1.log). If a Rust-gated feature turns out to be required by the YuE2 serving path, revisit with a rustup toolchain.
